narrative:
Comparable operating expenses were €173.9M in FY2025 (personnel €79.8M, IT €53.7M, depreciation €17.3M, other €23.1M). Through September 2026 they are €136.0M, 6% higher than last year and €4.4M over budget. The 9+3 forecast is €183.4M — a comparable cost-to-income ratio of 63.2% against a target below 60%.

Costs are planned by cost centre × account × entity across ten cost centres. IT is the largest non-staff line (€44.7M of systems and licences) while Oracle and Snowflake run in parallel.

Every GL line drills to the Basware purchase invoice behind it.
